prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 84.1%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.4%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Post-Adoption Desktop Controls Quick-Guide Screen: Add a dedicated visual guide screen right before home intro showing hotkeys and taskbar controls to hide, summon, and interact with the desktop pet. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control or hide the pet, and finish step conversion is only 64.8%.)
1: [choose_path, layout] Stage View Path Selection Cards: Re-layout the path selection screen into a stage spotlight view highlighting custom pet creation vs instant adopt options. (why: choose_path has a high mean duration of 514s indicating decision paralysis during path selection.)
2: [choose_path, copy] Clear Onboarding Story Duration Headline: Update the onboarding story intro headline to explicitly promise a 2-minute setup time. (why: choose_path conversion is 76.2% with a long mean duration; framing setting up as ultra-fast sets expectations.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Display Health Pre-Check Notice: Add a desktop display render status tip on the wait screen confirming graphics compatibility while pet assets load. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on desktop or app failing to launch post-onboarding.)
4: [finish, notification] Desktop Companion Welcome & First Interaction Prompt: Add an interactive mascot callout on the home intro screen showing how to feed and click the pet for the first time. (why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% and users express confusion after onboarding on how to talk to or interact with pets.)
